Author: qx
Name: Doman Mahjong Solver
Description: Reads your Doman Mahjong hand and either suggests the best discard or plays the match for you.
Changelog: v0.1.3.4: telemetry backoff default reduced from 30 min to 5 min. The upload target is a Cloudflare Workers endpoint (mahjong-telemetry.xeldaralz.workers.dev) - Cloudflare does NOT emit Retry-After headers on 429, so 30 min was far too long for the common case of a transient IP-level rate limit that clears in minutes. v0.1.3.3 introduced rate-limit parking with .rate-until-epoch markers (429 parks the file, scan skips it until the marker expires). v0.1.3.4 keeps that mechanism but uses a 5 min default (capped at 6h) so the system recovers faster after a brief Cloudflare throttle. Also: Retry-After header parsing handles both delta-seconds and HTTP-date forms; non-429 errors use a longer {15,30,60,120,120}s backoff schedule.
